LV-01a Nissan Cedric.text:
[[File:LV01abox.jpg|thumb|300px]]
'''LV-01a Nissan Cedric''' (LV-01a 日産 セドリック) is a toy released within the [[Tomica Limited Vintage (toyline)|Tomica Limited Vintage]] toyline. It is primarily released in Japan.

==Overview==
The Nissan Cedric was released January, 2004.

==Description==
The toy includes the main figure of the Nissan Cedric.

It is a 1/64 model of the real-life vehicle, manufactured by Nissan in the 1960's.
==Trivia==
* Its variants include [[LV-01b Nissan Cedric]], [[LV-01c Nissan Cedric]], [[LV-01d Nissan Cedric On-Site Taxi]], [[LV-01e Nissan Cedric]] and [[LV-01f Nissan Cedric]]. The "e" version is almost identical to this model, but its interior color differs.
* It was used as a base for variants in [[TLV Toho Meisha-za Deluxe Vol.4 "Crazy Adventure"]], [[TLV Toho Meisha-za Deluxe Vol.5 "Mexican Free-For-All"]], [[TLV Nihon Kotsu Taxi 2Models Vol. 1]], as well as the [[TLV Nissan Cedric Kitahara Taxi (Toys Club)|Nissan Cedric Kitahara Taxi (Toys Club)]], and [[LV-100 Commemorative Nissan Cedric]].

No. 101 Hino Selega.text:
[[File:101hinoselegabox.jpg|thumb|300px]]
'''Tomica No. 101 Hino Selega''' (トミカ No.101 日野セレガ) is a toy released within the classic [[Tomica]] toyline. It is primarily released in Japan.

==Overview==
The Hino Selega was released April 15, 2006, and retired September, 2016. It replaced the [[No. 101 Honda Odyssey Wagon Taxi]] and was succeeded by the [[No. 101 Isuzu Giga Dump Truck]].

==Description==
The toy includes the main figure of the Hino Selega.

It is a 1/156 model of the real-life vehicle. It has no special features.

Premium No. 01 Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune.text:
[[File:R34.png|thumb|300x300px]]
'''Tomica Premium No. 01 Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune''' is a toy released within the [[Tomica Premium (toyline)|Tomica Premium]] toyline. It is primarily released in Japan.

==Overview==
The Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune was released April 2, 2015, and retired July, 2019. It was succeeded by the [[Premium No. 01 Tomica Skyline Turbo Super Silhouette]].

==Description==
The toy includes the main figure of the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune.

It is a 1/62 model of the real-life vehicle. It has working suspension and its doors can be opened.
==Trivia==
* It is the 1st vehicle in this line to be assigned the number "01".
* It was used as a base for the [[Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune Proto. (Tokyo Auto Salon 2016)|Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune Proto.]].

LV-N Abunai Deka Vol.01 Nissan GT-R Prem.text:
[[File:Abudeka1.jpg|thumb|300px]]
'''LV-N Abunai Deka Vol.01 Nissan GT-R Premium Edition''' (LV-N あぶない刑事01 NISSAN GT-R Premium Edition) is a toy released within the [[Tomica Limited Vintage Neo (toyline)|Tomica Limited Vintage Neo]] toyline. It is primarily released in Japan.

==Overview==
The Abunai Deka Vol.01 Nissan GT-R Premium Edition was released February, 2016. It was the first release in the Abunai Deka series, inspired by vehicles from the 1986 TV drama series, "Abunai Deka" and 2016 sequel film, "Saraba Abunai Deka".

==Description==
The toy includes the main figure of the Nissan GT-R Premium Edition.

It is a 1/64 model of the real-life vehicle, manufactured by Nissan in the 2010's.
==Trivia==
* Its base is the [[LV-N116a Nissan GT-R Premium Edition|LV-N116 series]].
